svg.title: Raghad Beauty, an online store for a beauty shop in Nahef
svg.desc: Raghad Beauty: an online store for a beauty and hair-care shop in Nahef. You fill a cart and the order goes to the shop on WhatsApp. Lama built the delivery zones, the bundles and deals, the installable app and the opening animation, and signed off on every UX decision.
svg.text: A beauty shop in Nahef, now online
Fill a cart and the order lands with the shop on WhatsApp. I
built the delivery zones, the bundles and deals, the app you can
install, and the little opening animation. Every UX call on it
